summary: GreenPower Motor (NASDAQ: GP), a British Columbia foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the conversion of Series B convertible preferred shares held by entities controlled by CEO/Chairman Fraser Atkinson into 1,336,436 common shares — 324 preferred to 244,201 shares (Koko, Aug 6), 610 to 464,367 (NumberCo, Aug 18), and 818 to 627,868 (FWP Holdings, Aug 18). The 6-K corresponds to a Canadian material change report; an early warning report covers Atkinson. The issuer states the related-party issuance relies on MI 61-101 exemptions from formal valuation and minority approval. No pricing, premium, or board recommendation is stated; watch resulting insider-concentration and share-overhang effects.
